name: Sub-Package Scaffolding — Internal Logger Package
description: Create sub-package packages/logger with package.json, Logger class, and wire into src/app.ts.

inputs.task_prompt: Scaffold internal logger package: 1) In packages/logger/package.json create package '@app/logger'. 2) In packages/logger/src/index.ts implement Logger class with info, warn, error methods and formatLog(level, msg): string returning '[LEVEL] msg'. 3) In src/app.ts import Logger from '../packages/logger/src/index' and export startApp() which logs an info message. Ensure test/logger.test.ts passes.

acceptance_criteria: src/app.ts starts app and logs initialization message
constraints: formatLog must return uppercase level in brackets: '[INFO] ...'
